Frequently Reported Issues:

### Description ###
jQuery shouldn't auto-append "px" to CSS variables.:
```js
div.css( "--a", 3 ).css( "--a" ); // is: "3px", should be: "3"
```

### Link to test case ###
https://jsfiddle.net/uxj3znv0/
